findings.message:
Reentrancy in DEP_BANK.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0xaae1f51cf3339f18b6d3f3bdc75a5facd744b0b8.sol#47-60):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (../sb/0xaae1f51cf3339f18b6d3f3bdc75a5facd744b0b8.sol#54)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] -= _am (../sb/0xaae1f51cf3339f18b6d3f3bdc75a5facd744b0b8.sol#56)
	DEP_BANK.balances (../sb/0xaae1f51cf3339f18b6d3f3bdc75a5facd744b0b8.sol#11) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- DEP_BANK.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0xaae1f51cf3339f18b6d3f3bdc75a5facd744b0b8.sol#47-60)
	- DEP_BANK.Deposit() (../sb/0xaae1f51cf3339f18b6d3f3bdc75a5facd744b0b8.sol#39-45)
	- DEP_BANK.balances (../sb/0xaae1f51cf3339f18b6d3f3bdc75a5facd744b0b8.sol#11)
findings.name: reentrancy-eth
